# 0) Configuration

```{r}
LOCAL_PATH <- "/../environment/"     # adjust to your layout
PATH <- paste0(here(), LOCAL_PATH)

WOA_PO2_FILE  <- paste0(PATH, "data_out/woa18_all_pO2_kPa_an01.csv")  # pO2 in kPa
WOA_TEMP_FILE <- paste0(PATH, "data/woa18_95A4_t00an01.csv")          # temperature in °C

# Penn-style tolerances
T_TOL_C     <- 2.0    # discard if temp varies >2°C across depth interval around central estimate
O2_TOL_FRAC <- 0.20   # discard if pO2 varies >20% across depth interval around central estimate

# FishBase DemersPelag groupings (first pass)
labels_epipelagic <- c("pelagic", "pelagic-neritic", "pelagic-oceanic")
labels_demersal   <- c("demersal", "bathydemersal")

# OBIS parallelism
plan(multisession, workers = 64)     # tune to your machine / environment

# Dummy L-W conversion (FishBase Length -> mass proxy)
a_dummy <- 0.010
b_dummy <- 3.00

# Safety bounds for decade centers (k in [-10,10])
K_FLOOR <- -10
K_CEIL  <-  10

# Output
dir.create(here("figs"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(here("data"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```


# 1) Function helpers

```{r}
snap_1deg_center <- function(x) round(x / 1) * 1 + 0.5

woa_wide_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(starts_with("X"), names_to = "depth_m", values_to = value_name) %>%
    mutate(depth_m = as.numeric(sub("^X", "", depth_m)))
}

# Size bins centered on 10^k where k is integer:
# bin k is [10^(k-0.5), 10^(k+0.5))
make_decade_centered_bins <- function(mass_g, k_floor = -10, k_ceiling = 10) {
  lg <- log10(mass_g)
  lg <- lg[is.finite(lg)]

  if (length(lg) == 0) {
    k_min <- k_floor
    k_max <- k_ceiling
  } else {
    k_min <- floor(min(lg))
    k_max <- ceiling(max(lg))
    k_min <- max(k_min, k_floor)
    k_max <- min(k_max, k_ceiling)
  }

  ks <- seq(k_min, k_max, by = 1)
  edges <- 10^seq(k_min - 0.5, k_max + 0.5, by = 1)

  list(
    k = ks,
    breaks = edges,
    centers_g = 10^ks,
    labels = paste0("10^", ks, " g")
  )
}

get_fishbase_species <- function(labels, group_name) {
  fb_tbl("species") %>%
    transmute(
      sci_name = paste(Genus, Species),
      DemersPelag,
      Length,
      Saltwater
    ) %>%
    filter(Saltwater == 1, DemersPelag %in% labels) %>%
    mutate(
      mass_g = a_dummy * Length^b_dummy,
      group  = group_name
    ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(mass_g)) %>%
    distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

get_obis_one <- function(species) {
  tryCatch({
    x <- occurrence(species)
    if (!is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0) x %>% mutate(sci_name = species) else NULL
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

fetch_obis <- function(species_vec) {
  obis_list <- future_lapply(species_vec, get_obis_one)
  data <- bind_rows(obis_list)
  missing <- species_vec[which(vapply(obis_list, is.null, logical(1)))]
  list(data = data, missing = missing)
}

# Evaluate uncertainty of T and pO2 within [zmin,zmax] relative to the central estimate at midpoint depth
eval_depth_uncertainty <- function(profile_df, zmin, zmax, T_tol = 2, O2_tol_frac = 0.2) {
  if (nrow(profile_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  pr <- profile_df %>%
    filter(depth_m >= zmin, depth_m <= zmax) %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa))

  if (nrow(pr) == 0) return(NULL)

  zc <- (zmin + zmax) / 2

  # Central estimate at nearest WOA depth to midpoint
  pr <- pr %>%
    mutate(dist = abs(depth_m - zc)) %>%
    arrange(dist)

  T0  <- pr$temperature[1]
  O20 <- pr$po2_kPa[1]

  dT  <- max(abs(pr$temperature - T0), na.rm = TRUE)
  dO2 <- max(abs(pr$po2_kPa - O20) / pmax(O20, 1e-9), na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(
    central_depth_m = pr$depth_m[1],
    temperature = T0,
    po2_kPa = O20,
    dT_max = dT,
    dO2_max_frac = dO2,
    pass_uncertainty = (dT <= T_tol) & (dO2 <= O2_tol_frac)
  )
}
```


# 2) Load WOA and reshape

```{r}
woa_temp <- read.csv(WOA_TEMP_FILE)
woa_po2  <- read.csv(WOA_PO2_FILE)

woa_temp_long <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_temp, "temperature")
woa_po2_long  <- woa_wide_to_long(woa_po2,  "po2_kPa")

woa_long <- full_join(woa_temp_long, woa_po2_long,
                      by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m"))

# Ensure WOA has at most one row per (cell, depth). If duplicates exist, collapse them.
woa_long <- woa_long %>%
  group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth_m) %>%
  summarize(
    temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    po2_kPa     = mean(po2_kPa,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Make a fast lookup list: one profile per (LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
woa_groups <- woa_long %>% group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>% group_split()
woa_keys   <- woa_long %>% group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>% group_keys()
woa_profiles <- setNames(
  woa_groups,
  paste0(woa_keys$LATITUDE, "_", woa_keys$LONGITUDE)
)
get_profile <- function(lat, lon) woa_profiles[[paste0(lat, "_", lon)]]

# Precompute "seafloor" depth: deepest depth with any finite env for each WOA cell
woa_seafloor <- woa_long %>%
  filter(is.finite(temperature) | is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
  group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>%
  summarize(zfloor = max(depth_m, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```


# 3) FishBase species list

```{r}
# Epipelagic + demersal example
fb_epi <- get_fishbase_species(labels_epipelagic, "epipelagic")
fb_dem <- get_fishbase_species(labels_demersal,   "demersal")

fb_all <- bind_rows(fb_epi, fb_dem) %>%
  distinct(sci_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Decade-centered mass bins shared across both groups
bins <- make_decade_centered_bins(fb_all$mass_g, k_floor = K_FLOOR, k_ceiling = K_CEIL)

fb_all <- fb_all %>%
  mutate(
    mass_bin = cut(
      mass_g,
      breaks = bins$breaks,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE,
      labels = bins$labels
    )
  )

sp_lookup <- fb_all %>% select(sci_name, group, mass_g, mass_bin)
```


# 4) OBIS occurrences

```{r}
res_obis <- fetch_obis(sp_lookup$sci_name)
writeLines(res_obis$missing, here("data/missing_species.txt"))

obis <- res_obis$data %>%
  transmute(
    sci_name = if_else(is.na(sci_name), scientificName, sci_name),
    LATITUDE = decimalLatitude,
    LONGITUDE = decimalLongitude,
    zmin = as.numeric(minimumDepthInMeters),
    zmax = as.numeric(maximumDepthInMeters)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(LATITUDE), is.finite(LONGITUDE)) %>%
  left_join(sp_lookup, by = "sci_name") %>%
  filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(mass_bin))

# Snap to 1° WOA grid centers
obis <- obis %>%
  mutate(
    LATITUDE = snap_1deg_center(LATITUDE),
    LONGITUDE = snap_1deg_center(LONGITUDE)
  )
```


# 5) Processing and joining

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Depth rules (Penn-like)
#    - If only one of zmin/zmax present: set the other equal
#    - If neither present: use 0 -> seafloor, but only if WOA cell exists
# ---------------------------
obis2 <- obis %>%
  mutate(
    zmin = as.numeric(zmin),
    zmax = as.numeric(zmax),
    zmin = if_else(is.na(zmin) & !is.na(zmax), zmax, zmin),
    zmax = if_else(is.na(zmax) & !is.na(zmin), zmin, zmax)
  ) %>%
  left_join(woa_seafloor, by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE")) %>%
  mutate(
    zmin = if_else(is.na(zmin) & is.na(zmax), 0, zmin),
    zmax = if_else(is.na(zmax) & is.na(zmin), zfloor, zmax)
  ) %>%
  select(-zfloor) %>%
  filter(is.finite(zmin), is.finite(zmax), zmax >= zmin)
```


```{r}
# ---------------------------
# OPTIONAL SPEEDUP (recommended):
#    Deduplicate "environment queries" so you only evaluate WOA once per unique key.
#    Key choice: (LAT, LON, zmin, zmax, group, mass_bin)
#    If you want env to depend ONLY on (LAT,LON,zmin,zmax), drop group/mass_bin from distinct().
# ---------------------------
obis_q <- obis2 %>%
  distinct(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, zmin, zmax, group, mass_bin, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---------------------------
# 4) Attach WOA profile rows within each query's depth interval
#    This join is intentionally many-to-many (many queries per cell, many depths per cell).
# ---------------------------
obis_woa <- obis_q %>%
  inner_join(
    woa_long %>% select(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth_m, temperature, po2_kPa),
    by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
  filter(depth_m >= zmin, depth_m <= zmax)
```


```{r}
# If some queries have zero WOA depths in-range, they disappear here (that's fine).
# If you want to diagnose:
# anti <- obis_q %>% anti_join(obis_woa %>% distinct(LATITUDE,LONGITUDE,zmin,zmax,group,mass_bin),
#                             by=c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","zmin","zmax","group","mass_bin"))

# ---------------------------
# Penn-style central estimate + uncertainty test per query
#    Central estimate = nearest WOA depth to midpoint (zmin+zmax)/2
#    Reject if max deviation across interval exceeds tolerances.
# ---------------------------
env_q <- obis_woa %>%
  mutate(
    zc   = (zmin + zmax) / 2,
    dist = abs(depth_m - zc)
  ) %>%
  group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, zmin, zmax, group, mass_bin) %>%
  arrange(dist, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  summarize(
    central_depth_m = first(depth_m),
    temperature0    = first(temperature),
    po2_kPa0        = first(po2_kPa),

    dT_max = max(abs(temperature - first(temperature)), na.rm = TRUE),
    dO2_max_frac = max(abs(po2_kPa - first(po2_kPa)) / pmax(first(po2_kPa), 1e-9), na.rm = TRUE),

    pass_uncertainty = (dT_max <= T_TOL_C) & (dO2_max_frac <= O2_TOL_FRAC),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(temperature = temperature0, po2_kPa = po2_kPa0)

# ---------------------------
# Map env results back onto ALL occurrences (not just deduped queries)
#    IMPORTANT: combined will NOT contain depth_m; it contains central_depth_m.
# ---------------------------
combined <- obis2 %>%
  left_join(env_q, by = c("LATITUDE","LONGITUDE","zmin","zmax","group","mass_bin")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pass_uncertainty), pass_uncertainty) %>%
  filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
  mutate(
    temperature = pmax(pmin(temperature, 30), 0),
    po2_kPa     = pmax(pmin(po2_kPa,     30), 0),
    mass_bin    = droplevels(mass_bin)
  )

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(!("depth_m" %in% names(combined)))  # depth_m should NOT be in combined
# central depth should lie within interval (allow tiny numerical tolerance)
bad_cd <- mean(with(combined, central_depth_m < (zmin - 1e-9) | central_depth_m > (zmax + 1e-9)), na.rm = TRUE)
message("Fraction with central_depth outside [zmin,zmax]: ", signif(bad_cd, 3))
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------
# Combine cells in 3D space (LAT, LON, depth)
#    Reduces sampling bias
# ---------------------------

combined_cell <- combined %>%
  distinct(group, mass_bin, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, central_depth_m, temperature, po2_kPa)
```

```{r fig.width=10}
                                   na.value = "white",
```

# 7) Analysis

```{r}
# ============================================================
# F1-based pO2_crit (Penn-style pO2_act analogue) vs mass scaling
# USING combined_cell, restricted to mass bins 10^1 .. 10^6 g
#
# Outputs:
#   - tau_epi, tau_dem: F1-optimal thresholds per mass_bin
#   - b_epi, b_dem: slopes in log10(tau) ~ a + b log10(mass)
#   - plot of log10(tau) vs log10(mass) with fitted lines
#
# Assumes you already have:
#   - combined_cell: columns group, mass_bin, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE
#   - woa_long: columns LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, depth_m, temperature, po2_kPa
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ----------------------------
# Config
# ----------------------------
T0 <- 10
T_band <- 5
K_MIN <- -2
K_MAX <- 8
N_BG  <- 50000   # background subsample size (speed); set NULL for all
SEED  <- 1

# ----------------------------
# Helpers
# ----------------------------

calc_f1 <- function(tp, fp, fn) {
  precision <- tp / pmax(tp + fp, 1e-9)
  recall    <- tp / pmax(tp + fn, 1e-9)
  2 * precision * recall / pmax(precision + recall, 1e-9)
}

# Expects labels like "10^5 g"
parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

filter_bins_k <- function(df, k_min = 1, k_max = 6) {
  df %>%
    mutate(k_tmp = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
    filter(is.finite(k_tmp), k_tmp >= k_min, k_tmp <= k_max) %>%
    select(-k_tmp)
}

# Availability: for each WOA cell, take pO2 at the depth where T is closest to T0.
# Keep only cells where closest T is within T_band.
make_availability_isotherm <- function(woa_long, T0 = 10, T_band = 0.5) {
  woa_long %>%
    filter(is.finite(temperature), is.finite(po2_kPa)) %>%
    mutate(distT = abs(temperature - T0)) %>%
    group_by(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>%
    arrange(distT, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    summarize(
      distT_min = first(distT),
      po2_T0    = first(po2_kPa),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(distT_min <= T_band) %>%
    select(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, po2_T0)
}

# Compute F1-optimal threshold tau* given presences and availability universe
estimate_tau_f1 <- function(pres_cells, avail_cells, n_bg = 50000, seed = 1) {

  # Presence must fall within availability universe
  pres <- pres_cells %>%
    inner_join(avail_cells, by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE")) %>%
    mutate(presence = 1L)

  if (nrow(pres) < 20) return(NULL)

  bg <- avail_cells %>%
    anti_join(pres_cells, by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE")) %>%
    mutate(presence = 0L)

  if (!is.null(n_bg) && nrow(bg) > n_bg) {
    set.seed(seed)
    bg <- bg %>% slice_sample(n = n_bg)
  }

  dat <- bind_rows(
    pres %>% select(po2_T0, presence),
    bg   %>% select(po2_T0, presence)
  ) %>%
    filter(is.finite(po2_T0))

  taus <- as.numeric(quantile(dat$po2_T0, probs = seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01), na.rm = TRUE))

  curve <- map_dfr(taus, function(tau) {
    pred <- as.integer(dat$po2_T0 >= tau)
    tp <- sum(pred == 1 & dat$presence == 1)
    fp <- sum(pred == 1 & dat$presence == 0)
    fn <- sum(pred == 0 & dat$presence == 1)
    tibble(tau_kPa = tau, F1 = calc_f1(tp, fp, fn), tp = tp, fp = fp, fn = fn)
  })

  best <- curve %>% arrange(desc(F1), tau_kPa) %>% slice(1)
  list(best = best, curve = curve)
}

# Run F1 thresholds per mass_bin for a given group, using combined_cell presences
tau_by_massbin <- function(combined_cell, woa_long, group_name,
                           T0 = 10, T_band = 0.5,
                           n_bg = 50000, seed = 1,
                           k_min = 1, k_max = 6) {

  avail <- make_availability_isotherm(woa_long, T0 = T0, T_band = T_band)

  occ <- combined_cell %>%
    filter(group == group_name) %>%
    distinct(mass_bin, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE) %>%
    filter_bins_k(k_min = k_min, k_max = k_max)

  bins <- sort(unique(as.character(occ$mass_bin)))

  map_dfr(bins, function(bn) {
    pres_cells <- occ %>% filter(mass_bin == bn) %>% distinct(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
    out <- estimate_tau_f1(pres_cells, avail, n_bg = n_bg, seed = seed)

    if (is.null(out)) {
      return(tibble(mass_bin = bn, tau_kPa = NA_real_, F1 = NA_real_, n_presence = nrow(pres_cells)))
    }

    tibble(
      mass_bin = bn,
      tau_kPa = out$best$tau_kPa,
      F1 = out$best$F1,
      tp = out$best$tp,
      fp = out$best$fp,
      fn = out$best$fn,
      n_presence = nrow(pres_cells)
    )
  })
}

# Fit scaling log10(tau) = a + b log10(mass), with mass centers = 10^k
fit_b_from_tau <- function(tau_df, k_min = 1, k_max = 6) {
  tau_df <- filter_bins_k(tau_df, k_min = k_min, k_max = k_max)

  dd <- tau_df %>%
    filter(is.finite(tau_kPa), tau_kPa > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin),
      mass_center_g = 10^k,
      log10_tau = log10(tau_kPa),
      log10_m   = log10(mass_center_g)
    )

  fit <- lm(log10_tau ~ log10_m, data = dd)
  list(data = dd, fit = fit, coef = coef(fit))
}

# ----------------------------
# Run analysis
# ----------------------------

# F1-optimal thresholds per mass bin
tau_epi <- tau_by_massbin(combined_cell, woa_long, "epipelagic",
                          T0 = T0, T_band = T_band, n_bg = N_BG, seed = SEED,
                          k_min = K_MIN, k_max = K_MAX)

tau_dem <- tau_by_massbin(combined_cell, woa_long, "demersal",
                          T0 = T0, T_band = T_band, n_bg = N_BG, seed = SEED,
                          k_min = K_MIN, k_max = K_MAX)

# Fit mass scaling and extract b
fit_epi <- fit_b_from_tau(tau_epi, k_min = K_MIN, k_max = K_MAX)
fit_dem <- fit_b_from_tau(tau_dem, k_min = K_MIN, k_max = K_MAX)

b_epi <- unname(fit_epi$coef["log10_m"])
b_dem <- unname(fit_dem$coef["log10_m"])

cat("F1-optimal pO2 threshold scaling at ~", T0, "°C (±", T_band, "°C)\n", sep = "")
cat("Mass bins: 10^", K_MIN, " to 10^", K_MAX, " g\n", sep = "")
cat("epipelagic b = ", signif(b_epi, 4), "\n", sep = "")
cat("demersal   b = ", signif(b_dem, 4), "\n\n", sep = "")

cat("Epipelagic fit summary:\n")
print(summary(fit_epi$fit))
cat("\nDemersal fit summary:\n")
print(summary(fit_dem$fit))

# ----------------------------
# Plot results
# ----------------------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(
  fit_epi$data %>% mutate(group = "epipelagic"),
  fit_dem$data %>% mutate(group = "demersal")
)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log10_m, y = log10_tau, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "log10(mass center, g)",
    y = "log10(F1-optimal pO2 threshold τ*, kPa)",
    title = paste0("Mass scaling of F1-optimal pO2 threshold at ~", T0, "°C (±", T_band, "°C)")
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- Settings ---
T_LO <- 5
T_HI <- 15
K_MIN <- 0
K_MAX <- 6
Q_LOW <- 0.10  # 10th percentile threshold (set 0.05 for more "lower envelope")

parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

# Choose which group(s) to analyze:
# set group_filter <- NULL to pool groups
group_filter <- c("epipelagic", "demersal")  # or just "epipelagic"

# --- Build thresholds ---
df_band <- combined_cell %>%
  filter(temperature >= T_LO, temperature <= T_HI) %>%
  mutate(k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(k), k >= K_MIN, k <= K_MAX) %>%
  { if (is.null(group_filter)) . else filter(., group %in% group_filter) } %>%
  filter(is.finite(po2_kPa), po2_kPa > 0)

thr_df <- df_band %>%
  group_by(group, k) %>%
  summarize(
    mass_center_g = 10^k,
    n_cells = n(),  # number of cell observations contributing
    po2_thr_kPa = as.numeric(quantile(po2_kPa, probs = Q_LOW, na.rm = TRUE)),
    po2_median_kPa = median(po2_kPa, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(po2_thr_kPa))

# --- Fit mass scaling (log-log): log10(thr) ~ a + b log10(mass) ---
fit_tbl <- thr_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    dd <- .x %>%
      mutate(log10_m = log10(mass_center_g),
             log10_thr = log10(po2_thr_kPa))
    fit <- lm(log10_thr ~ log10_m, data = dd)
    tibble(
      a = unname(coef(fit)[1]),
      b = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
      r2 = summary(fit)$r.squared,
      n_bins = nrow(dd)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

print(fit_tbl)

# --- Plot threshold vs mass (log-log) ---
ggplot(thr_df, aes(x = mass_center_g, y = po2_thr_kPa, color = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Mass bin center (g)",
    y = paste0("pO2 threshold (", Q_LOW*100, "th percentile), kPa"),
    title = paste0("Lower-envelope pO2 threshold vs mass (T in ", T_LO, "–", T_HI, "°C)")
  )
```
